MINIO_ROOT_USER.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: MinIO root (admin) username. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_USER}}.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: MinIO root password — auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}.

MINIO_ADDRESS.name: MINIO_ADDRESS
MINIO_ADDRESS.description: MinIO listen address. Port 8080 matches Railway's injected PORT so health checks can reach it.

PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: Railway-injected port. Minio API listens on this port.
